text: Design for safe and supportable operation.

A useful engineered solution needs more than its headline performance. Information may need protection against unauthorized disclosure, alteration and loss of availability. People also need training, safe procedures, spare parts and maintenance arrangements. Choices made early in development can create large burdens later, so these concerns belong within technical trade-offs from the outset.

items: Illustration: A high-scoring platform still provides little practical value if its replacement parts cannot be obtained during service.

text: Include people, protection, maintenance and supply when comparing design options.
Technical strength at delivery does not guarantee useful service.
